# Fixtures

Illustrative sports events are generated by `packages/sports-engine/src/index.ts`; the preview guide is supplied by `packages/ui/src/demo.ts`. Adapter tests construct synthetic native guide/player DOM, and worker tests use mocked browser and storage APIs.

Fixtures have no account or stream authority. Fixture/REPLAY targets cannot become eligible LIVE navigation targets. Do not replace missing runtime data with illustrative scores or targets. See [tests](../README.md).
